metadata.title: That 1 lucky shot where Valorant said ‘Here, have a kill’ and I’m still confused
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just accidentally win a fight?
My brain was AFK but enemy wasn’t paying attention.
Click if your best plays come from pure chaos and luck.
Valorant logic is peak trolling today.

Tap if your kills come with zero effort but max confusion!
